title: model-specific runtime optimizations: llama/mistral/qwen quirks + GQA/MQA tuning
author: Ava Chen
description: This PR applies model-specific runtime optimizations and heuristics to improve throughput and tail latency for Llama, Mistral and Qwen families, plus tuning for GQA/MQA group sizes. Motivation: recent production workloads showed 8-18% higher per-token cost and elevated tail latency for short interactive requests on mixed-model fleets. Changes target kernel selection, attention rotary handling, KV cache layout and continuous batching scheduler heuristics so we get predictable SLOs across model quirks. Summary of changes: - Kernel selector: add model-aware heuristics to prefer vectorized kernels for Qwen XL when sequence length < 512 and per-token compute dominates; introduce fallback path for Qwen family to avoid pathological memory access patterns. - Rotary/rotary-2 handling for Llama: fix rotation stride calculation for 4-byte quantized paths to avoid extra casts that caused perf regressions; add unit + perf tests. - Mistral attention gating: add packed QKV path when Mistral block size aligns to 128, reducing memory copies and improving instruction-level parallelism on A100/A10. - GQA/MQA tuning: introduce group-size autotuner and compile-time thresholds; default GQA group sizes for large models set to 16, MQA to 8 for latency-sensitive tiers. - KV cache layout: change from vector-of-buffers to contiguous per-sequence layout for common short-session workloads; add fast-evict for continuous batching eviction edge-cases. - Continuous batching scheduler: new tail-latency-aware batching window (adaptive window between 8-30ms), prefer low-latency dispatch for high-qps short requests; added diagnostic traces. - Backcompat: keep old paths behind config flags and runtime feature gate; no public API change. Benchmarks: microbenchmarks on p4d and a100 show 10-18% throughput gains for Qwen-small/medium at seq<=256, 6-12% for Llama-2 13B in quantized modes, and 4-9% tail-latency reduction for mixed workloads with continuous batching enabled. See perf/benchmarks/notes.md for full details. CI: added perf CI stage and new unit tests. Migration notes: ops teams should see a toggle in runtime config to opt into GQA/MQA autotuner (disabled by default for Dedicated customers until staged rollout).
